title: Asset and Drop Again
author: Edmund Ashgrove
blurb: Odile Villalobos, an interpreter attached to a peace delegation destined to fail, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must burn the network that did the training, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
